uncertain_terms.note: File id is QCD-024 but the document number and title are T-106-R0A, and the body is an electrical work order (WOF-style), not a QC form; translated verbatim.
Older terminology 'Industrial Safety Category'; rendered as-is (WOF-002/003 use 'السلامة والصحة المهنية').
Source typo for 'أو الإخلال' (or breach); rendered by intent.
Source sentence is truncated here ('ونتعهد بعمل الاراضى الاضافية اللازمة وال بالامر'); a word is missing after 'وال'; rendered with a gap, no wording invented.
Source typo for 'التصريح اليومى' (daily permit); rendered 'Daily permit'.
Source typo for 'وجود الجهد' (presence of voltage); rendered by intent.
Source typo for 'منفذ العمل' (Work Executor); rendered by intent.
Source typo for 'تحت رئاستنا' (under our supervision); rendered by intent.
Source typo for 'يوم' (day); rendered by intent.
Team table numbering carries an 'أ' prefix in this document (plain numbers in WOF-003); kept verbatim.
Time field rendered 'hour minute', following the source field order (hour, then minute).
